notes.notPublishedBody: Your lecturer is reviewing them. Meanwhile, the full transcript is available.
notes.notReadyBody: This usually takes a few minutes after the lecture ends.
notes.pendingBanner: Regenerating notes from the transcript… This page will update when they're ready.
notes.draftBanner: Draft — students can't see these notes until you publish them.
notes.published: Notes published. Students can now see them.
notes.publishConfirmBody: Students in this subject will be able to read them. You can still edit them afterwards.
notes.regenerateConfirmBody: This replaces the current notes, including your edits, with a fresh AI-generated version.
notes.emptySections: These notes have no sections yet.

editor.title: Editing notes
editor.heading: Heading
editor.bodyHint: Use **bold**, lists with -, and tables. Raw HTML is ignored.
editor.conflict: These notes were changed elsewhere. Reload to see the latest version, then reapply your edits.

validation.heading: Every section needs a heading.
validation.bodyLong: This section is too long (20,000 characters maximum).

errors.generic: Couldn't save the notes. Your edits are still here — try again.

summary.notReadyBody: It's generated after the lecture ends.

keyTerms.notReadyBody: They're extracted after the lecture ends.

questions.intro: Practice questions for revision. Your answers aren't saved or graded.
questions.notReadyBody: They're generated after the lecture ends.

ask.intro: Ask a question about this lecture. Answers are based only on its transcript, with links to the exact moments.
ask.label: Your question
ask.placeholder: e.g. Why does a very small time quantum hurt performance?
ask.noCitations: This answer isn't linked to any part of the transcript. Check it against the lecture before relying on it.
ask.empty: No questions yet. Try asking about a topic from the lecture.

validation.short: Ask a slightly longer question (at least 3 characters).

errors.rateLimited: You're asking quickly. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.generic: Couldn't get an answer. Please try again.

flashcards.intro: Test yourself: read the question, answer it in your head, then reveal the answer.
flashcards.none: No flashcards were generated for this lecture.
flashcards.notReadyBody: They're generated after the lecture ends.

revision.notReadyBody: They're generated after the lecture ends.
